District of Columbia Unemployment Rate at 5.6 Percent in September
(Washington, DC)
– The District of Columbia’s Department of Employment Services (DOES) reported today that the seasonally adjusted preliminary unemployment rate was 5.6 percent in September 2026, a decrease of 0.1 percentage point from the revised August 2026 rate of 5.7 percent.
Washington Metro’s Unemployment Rate at 5.0 percent
(Washington, DC)
- The District of Columbia’s Department of Employment Services (DOES) reported today that the preliminary August job estimates show a decrease of 20,200 jobs for a total of 1,083,100 jobs in the Washington, DC-MD Metropolitan Division. The private sector decreased by 6,700 jobs, while the public sector decreased by 13,500 jobs.
